title: Touge Oni: Primal Gods in Ancient Times
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In the ancient land of Wa, when kami and humans lived side by side, the orphan girl Miyo is chosen as her village's sacrifice to its god. The wandering mystic-monk En no Ozuno, who can speak with gods, and his companions change her fate, and she leaves her village to travel with them. Each story visits a different kami with its own temper, past and sacred instrument, with time travel woven in.
life_message: A person need not accept a fate others assign; courage and curiosity can open a wider world.
